newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu Construction ask-only on Osaka bourse.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu Construction ask-only on Osaka bourse.

text.p: Shares of Isuzu Construction Co Ltd were ask-only on the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) on Monday morning after the company announced on Friday that it planned to go into liquidation.
Isuzu Construction was ask-only at 175 yen at 0115 GMT after closing at 190 on Friday.
Isuzu Construction said in a statement that it would formally decide on liquidation at a board meeting to be held on March 15.
It said its debts totalled 59.1 billion yen.
The Osaka Securities Exchange announced separately on Friday that Isuzu would be delisted from the exchange on March 18.
